description: Claude Desktop sessions, memory and plan limit in the left corner of the Windows 11 taskbar
notes: Run 'claudibeat --setup' once: it installs the status-band mod for Claude Desktop, turns on starting with Windows and starts the strip.
pre_install: Get-Process claudibeat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 | ForEach-Object { Start-Process $_.Path -ArgumentList '--quit' -Wait }
